name: pc-parts-flipper
description: Local tool for sourcing, tearing down, and reselling used pre-built computer parts.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && concurrently -n web,server -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
